evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable features: searching and discovering (recommendation/browsing) using fingerprinting.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Combines search and discovery as separable features even if driven by the same profile signal.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Includes two features (search + discovery) that could be implemented/tested/prioritized separately.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: Combines search and discovery; also spans two content types (music and ringback tones) which could be separate deliverables.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Search and discovery are distinct features; using metadata/image tags is an implementation approach but the two user-facing capabilities remain separable.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Combines uploading tagged videos with a separate requirement about tag propagation/availability in downstream processing.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying thumbnail sequences for segments.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: retrieving information about similarity results (items/segments are part of the same similarity-info feature).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: retrieving info about perceptual similarity for items/segments.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendations based on similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendations driven by local news events.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Two separable features: (1) person identification, (2) presenting related information about identified persons.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines product identification with a separate feature of retrieving/displaying related product information.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Two features: logo detection/identification and providing related information.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Two independently implementable features: brand identification and related-info retrieval/presentation.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Combines image capture/upload with a separate recommendation feature based on that image.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Combines at least two features: map-based content access and notifications/informing about available videos/POIs in the area.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ASR-based search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Three separable features: viewing segmentation, validating it, and editing it.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines annotation with topic extraction, which can be implemented/tested separately.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are distinct, independently testable features.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: edited-before-upload assessment.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: nudity prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefiltering via low-level-asset-information search.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automated copyright-infringement validation.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefiltering via high-level-asset-information search (metadata/tags are attributes of the same feature).

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: assessing picture interestingness/appeal/complexity; the listed inputs are attributes/sources for the same assessment.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detection of when to prompt a scientist; inputs are part of the same decision feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: volunteer-type identification.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: preclassification using low-level features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detecting empty/unclassifiable-animal images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image series detection to handle timestamp malfunction.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting/number detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation and localization are distinct capabilities that can be implemented/tested separately (even if related).

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detecting images without classifiable plankton.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size detection and orientation detection are separable features (could be delivered independently).

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Combines motion analysis with a separate feature/goal of reducing video duration (e.g., trimming/summarization) which could be implemented separately.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: egg-laying time detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc
evaluations.rationale: Bundles multiple independently detectable feature types (flooding, damage, shelters, blocked roads) that could be prioritized and tested separately.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: weighting classifications by volunteer experience.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: artefact removal/prefiltering; examples enumerate artefact types within the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving-object detection and transient-object detection are separable features.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Background-noise removal and removal of distracting sounds can be implemented/tested separately.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: clustering/grouping similar whale calls.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: estimating whale count from audio.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: interruption timing decision.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Combines the interruption decision with selecting the interruption modality (text/image/video), which can be treated as a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: education timing decision.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Combines deciding to educate with choosing the education modality, which are separable features.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting the education content.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detecting interesting comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deciding when the bot should comment.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deciding when the bot should explain.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting/generating bot message content.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: similarity-based grouping.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: project recommendation based on prior experience.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing article summaries (the 'reuse' clause is a goal, not an additional feature).
